summary: Constellation Brands filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing entry into a $300 million delayed-draw Term Loan Credit Agreement with M&T Bank as administrative agent and other lenders, alongside item 2.03 disclosure of the resulting direct financial obligation. The facility permits up to two draws, commitments terminating at the earlier of full draw, second funding, or June 18, 2027; loans mature two years after initial borrowing and price at Term SOFR plus 70-110 bps or Base Rate plus 0-10 bps, with a 0.075% ticking fee after 30 days. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation; watch drawdown timing and leverage covenants.
